material.rule: AQS-STD-002 Rev F, rules M2 and M5. Leach liquor 70-85 C (GLOSSARY Leach/Salria; AQS-DUTY-008 HX-5 basis 77.5 C) exceeds PVC-U 60 C; CPVC to 93 C [S3]. No metal wetted part.

density_kg_m3.note: Spears engineering guide, CPVC specific gravity 1.51 [S3].

material.temperature_check: Liquor 77.5 C design, 70-85 C band (graph param liquor_T_C). CPVC limit 93 C [S3]; high trip 88 C (assumption). HX-5 is a glass coil (AQS-STD-002 3.3). Wall checked at 85 C in AQS-DUTY-050.

header_zone_mm.note: Assumption. Depth reserved on each Y face inside the envelope for the inlet and outlet headers. Belts (56 mm) sit inside it on the Y faces.

wall_mm.note: AQS-DUTY-050: 5/8 in CPVC sheet; panel stress 1.37 MPa at the floor against 3.03 MPa allowable at 85 C (study).

floor_mm.note: From AQS-NZ-001 floor 16 mm, now PVC.

lid_bolt.note: Assumption. Non-metallic fasteners in the acid-gas head space (AQS-STD-002 M4).

header_od_mm.note: Assumption. 2 in Sch 80 PVC, ASTM D1785 OD.

port_od_mm_bore_not_calculated.note: Assumption. 1 in Sch 80 PVC placeholder; bore not calculated.

port_pitch_mm.note: Assumption. Ports spread along X about the face center at Z 700.

belts.section: FRP pultruded channel C203x56x6.4, web on the wall, wrapped all round
belts.note: Study, AQS-DUTY-050. Density and allowable are assumptions pending the pultrusion vendor sheet.

liquor_density_kg_m3.note: Study. Dilute HCl with dissolved metal chlorides; replaced by a measured density.

hx5_coil.basis: AQS-DUTY-049, natural convection case (agitator held), 7.941 kW rated

arrangement.value: two concentric helices D 600 and 900 mm, 11.5 turns at 50 mm pitch, 600 mm tall, on four PTFE pads at z 100 mm
arrangement.note: Assumption. Envelope modeled as one annulus OD 925 / ID 575 x 600 mm.

agitator.wetted: PVDF-sheathed shaft and solid PVDF impeller; no metal wetted (AQS-STD-002 M3)
agitator.drive: gearmotor on a lid bridge, about 400 mm above the lid, outside the graph envelope (not modeled)
